capabilities: Display any vault image as an interactive map
Place markers and polygon regions linked to vault notes
Organize features into toggleable named layers
Link maps hierarchically for drill-down navigation
Calibrate a scale and measure distances with a ruler tool
disambiguation: It does not draw or generate maps; it displays an existing image with interactive markers, regions, and note links.
extras: Map data is stored in Obsidian's plugin data storage inside the vault, which the README notes aids backup and cross-device sync. The README states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to place notes, tags, and labeled connections on an image-based map.
summary: Interactive map viewer that displays vault images with markers, regions, layers, and links to vault notes.
